_note: Every number this deck STATES is either read off a verbatim quote or computed from quotes by out/2026-09-21/compute.py, which runs at build time rather than being copied. This file declares the ones the deck asserts as counts, ratios and spans, with the claims each was counted from. compute.py's docstring names the four things it REFUSES to compute and why, and the largest of those is that the three reported counts do not contain one another, so no difference between them is declared here or drawn anywhere. ONE CORRECTION, MADE AFTER AN INTEGRITY JUDGE CAUGHT IT. An earlier cut of this file said, in this note AND in the 39 of the 57 row's own computed_by, that the deck 'states the pair and never the percentage'. That was wrong as written, and the row was still saying it one round after the note above it was corrected, which is the same mistake this run made in the topics ledger: 68% IS on frame 5, inside the memo's own sentence set on the drawn page, and it is declared below. The rule the deck actually keeps is narrower and worth stating exactly. It never COMPUTES a percentage of its own, and it never prints one as the deck's own voice. Quoting the source's sentence whole, on a drawing of the source, is not the deck asserting a ratio. The distinction matters here because West separately gives 70% of a different grouping, and a deck that recomputed its own figure would be putting a third number beside two the record already disagrees about. The judge also noted that copy.json is built from render_report.json's text_nodes, which exclude canvas fillText, so frame 5's sentence is a published string no downstream check reads. That is a real gap in the SUITE and it is in the upgrade backlog rather than answered by retyping this file. The 68% is therefore NOT declared as a row below, and that absence is deliberate rather than an oversight: aggregate_check can only match a declaration against a phrase it can find, it reads copy.json and the caption, and frame 5's sentence is on canvas where neither looks. A declared row nothing can be matched to is what this gate calls a declaration waiting to be reused wrongly, and it refuses one for that reason. So the fact is recorded here in prose and the gate's blind spot is in knowledge/carousel/UPGRADE_BACKLOG.md, which is where a fix belongs.
